article_notes: Nothing extracted. 15 PCR-positive dogs (Babesia, Ehrlichia or mixed infection; species and the split by pathogen not given) at a veterinary college outpatient department in Bengaluru, India. Results are only the frequencies of ECG abnormalities in the whole group (Table 1); no severity or outcome groups, no comparison with controls. The anaemia-grade ECG findings in the Discussion are cited from another study (Champion et al. 2013), not the authors' own data.
